description: This Scala source file defines the ApplicationInfoWrapperSerializer class, which handles serialization and deserialization of ApplicationInfoWrapper objects for Spark's status protobuf data. It includes methods to serialize/deserialize application info and attempt info, utilizing protobuf builders and utility functions.

classes.name: ApplicationInfoWrapperSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for ApplicationInfoWrapper objects, providing methods to serialize to and deserialize from protobuf byte arrays.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an ApplicationInfoWrapper object into a byte array.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into an ApplicationInfoWrapper object.

methods.name: serializeApplicationInfo
methods.description: Converts ApplicationInfo into its protobuf StoreTypes.ApplicationInfo representation.

methods.name: serializeApplicationAttemptInfo
methods.description: Converts ApplicationAttemptInfo into its protobuf StoreTypes.ApplicationAttemptInfo representation.
